info.title: NEXTAN Costing & Quote Generator API
info.description: Internal costing sheets and client-facing branded quote exports.

post.description:
Purpose: Authenticate a user and return JWT access + refresh token pair.
Inputs: LoginRequest (username, password)
Outputs: TokenPair
Owner: [Claude]

Purpose: Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token.
Inputs: TokenRefreshRequest (refresh_token)
Outputs: AccessToken
Owner: [Claude]

get.description:
Purpose: Return the authenticated user's profile.
Inputs: JWT Bearer token (via dependency)
Outputs: UserRead
Owner: [Claude]

Purpose: List all active (non-deleted) organisations; supports optional name search.
Inputs: q (Optional[str]) — name substring filter
Outputs: list[OrganisationRead]
Owner: [Claude]

schema.title: Response List Organisations Api V1 Organisations Get

post.description:
Purpose: Create a new organisation in the shared client database.
Inputs: OrganisationCreate (name, address)
Outputs: OrganisationRead
Owner: [Claude]

get.description:
Purpose: Typeahead autocomplete — returns id+name only for lightweight dropdown.
Inputs: q (str) — search prefix
Outputs: list[OrganisationAutocomplete]
Owner: [Claude]

schema.title: Response Autocomplete Organisations Api V1 Organisations Autocomplete Get

get.description:
Purpose: Retrieve a single organisation by ID (active only).
Inputs: org_id (str UUID path param)
Outputs: OrganisationRead
Owner: [Claude]

put.description:
Purpose: Update name or address of an organisation.
Inputs: org_id (str UUID), OrganisationUpdate (name, address — both optional)
Outputs: OrganisationRead
Owner: [Claude]

delete.description:
Purpose: Soft-delete an organisation (set deleted_at). FK on CostingSheet remains intact.
         Hard delete is blocked to protect CostingSheet relational history.
Inputs: org_id (str UUID)
Outputs: 204 No Content
Owner: [Claude]

get.description:
Purpose: List all active contacts for an organisation.
Inputs: org_id (str UUID path param)
Outputs: list[ContactRead]
Owner: [Claude]

schema.title: Response List Contacts Api V1 Organisations  Org Id  Contacts Get

post.description:
Purpose: Create a new contact within an organisation.
Inputs: org_id (str UUID), ContactCreate (name, email, phone)
Outputs: ContactRead
Owner: [Claude]

get.description:
Purpose: Typeahead autocomplete for contacts within an organisation.
Inputs: org_id (str UUID), q (str) — name search prefix
Outputs: list[ContactAutocomplete]
Owner: [Claude]

schema.title: Response Autocomplete Contacts Api V1 Organisations  Org Id  Contacts Autocomplete Get

get.description:
Purpose: Get a single contact by ID (active only).
Inputs: contact_id (str UUID)
Outputs: ContactRead
Owner: [Claude]

put.description:
Purpose: Update a contact's name, email, or phone.
Inputs: contact_id (str UUID), ContactUpdate
Outputs: ContactRead
Owner: [Claude]

delete.description:
Purpose: Soft-delete a contact (set deleted_at). FK on CostingSheet remains intact.
Inputs: contact_id (str UUID)
Outputs: 204 No Content
Owner: [Claude]

post.description:
Purpose: Create a new costing sheet. Atomically reserves the next ref number
         for this user in the current month via INSERT...ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE.
Inputs: CostingSheetCreate
Outputs: CostingSheetRead
Owner: [Claude]

get.description:
Purpose: List the authenticated user's costing sheets with optional filters.
Inputs: client_name, ref_number, date_from, date_to (all optional query params)
Outputs: list[CostingSheetList]
Owner: [Claude]

schema.title: Response List Costing Sheets Api V1 Costing Sheets Get

get.description:
Purpose: Get a single costing sheet with its scenarios (line items loaded separately).
Inputs: sheet_id (str UUID)
Outputs: CostingSheetRead
Owner: [Claude]

put.description:
Purpose: Update costing sheet header and terms fields.
Inputs: sheet_id (str UUID), CostingSheetUpdate
Outputs: CostingSheetRead
Owner: [Claude]

delete.description:
Purpose: Delete a costing sheet. Blocked with 409 if any QuoteExport records exist.
Inputs: sheet_id (str UUID)
Outputs: 204 No Content
Owner: [Claude]

post.description:
Purpose: Duplicate a costing sheet — new ref number, today's date, all scenarios copied.
Inputs: sheet_id (str UUID)
Outputs: CostingSheetRead — the new duplicate sheet
Owner: [Claude]

Purpose: Create a new scenario within a costing sheet.
Inputs: sheet_id (str UUID), ScenarioCreate
Outputs: ScenarioRead
Owner: [Claude]

get.description:
Purpose: List all scenarios for a costing sheet.
Inputs: sheet_id (str UUID)
Outputs: list[ScenarioRead]
Owner: [Claude]

schema.title: Response List Scenarios Api V1 Costing Sheets  Sheet Id  Scenarios Get

get.description:
Purpose: Get a single scenario (line items loaded via separate endpoint).
Inputs: scenario_id (str UUID)
Outputs: ScenarioRead
Owner: [Claude]

put.description:
Purpose: Update scenario name, discount, show_gst, or notes_exclusions.
Inputs: scenario_id (str UUID), ScenarioUpdate
Outputs: ScenarioRead
Owner: [Claude]

delete.description:
Purpose: Delete a scenario. Blocked with 409 if any QuoteExport records exist for it.
Inputs: scenario_id (str UUID)
Outputs: 204 No Content
Owner: [Claude]

post.description:
Purpose: Create a top-level line item or bundle sub-component within a scenario.
Inputs: scenario_id (str UUID), LineItemCreate
Outputs: LineItemRead with computed pricing
Owner: [Claude]

get.description:
Purpose: List all top-level line items for a scenario, with bundle sub-components nested.
         Uses selectinload(depth=2) to avoid N+1 on bundles.
Inputs: scenario_id (str UUID)
Outputs: list[LineItemRead] with computed pricing
Owner: [Claude]

schema.title: Response List Line Items Api V1 Scenarios  Scenario Id  Line Items Get

get.description:
Purpose: Get a single line item with computed pricing and sub-components.
Inputs: line_item_id (str UUID)
Outputs: LineItemRead
Owner: [Claude]

put.description:
Purpose: Update a line item. If the item is a sub-component, clears the parent bundle override
         atomically in the same transaction.
Inputs: line_item_id (str UUID), LineItemUpdate
Outputs: LineItemRead with computed pricing
Owner: [Claude]

delete.description:
Purpose: Delete a line item. Cascades to sub-components (via DB ON DELETE CASCADE).
Inputs: line_item_id (str UUID)
Outputs: 204 No Content
Owner: [Claude]

post.description:
Purpose: Add a sub-component to a bundle parent. Clears parent bundle override.
Inputs: line_item_id (str UUID, bundle parent), LineItemCreate
Outputs: LineItemRead (the new sub-component)
Owner: [Claude]

patch.description:
Purpose: Set or clear the bundle manual override price.
         Send bundle_override_price=null to clear the override.
Inputs: line_item_id (str UUID, must be bundle parent), BundleOverridePatch
Outputs: LineItemRead
Owner: [Claude]

put.description:
Purpose: Bulk update display_order for top-level line items in a scenario.
Inputs: scenario_id (str UUID), ReorderRequest (list of {id, display_order})
Outputs: 204 No Content
Owner: [Claude]

get.description:
Purpose: Return current exchange rates from open.er-api.com (1hr cached).
         Base currency is always SGD.
Inputs: none
Outputs: LiveRatesResponse
Owner: [Claude]

Purpose: List all FX rate overrides for a costing sheet.
Inputs: sheet_id (str UUID)
Outputs: list[FXRateOverrideRead]
Owner: [Claude]

schema.title: Response List Fx Overrides Api V1 Costing Sheets  Sheet Id  Fx Overrides Get

post.description:
Purpose: Create or replace an FX override for a currency pair on a sheet.
         Upserts on (costing_sheet_id, base_currency, target_currency).
Inputs: sheet_id (str UUID), FXRateOverrideCreate
Outputs: FXRateOverrideRead
Owner: [Claude]

put.description:
Purpose: Update the override rate for an FX override record.
Inputs: override_id (str UUID), FXRateOverrideUpdate
Outputs: FXRateOverrideRead
Owner: [Claude]

delete.description:
Purpose: Delete an FX override. Reverts to live rate for that currency pair.
Inputs: override_id (str UUID)
Outputs: 204 No Content
Owner: [Claude]

get.description:
Purpose: List sheet-specific T&C bullet points.
Inputs: sheet_id (str UUID)
Outputs: list[TncRead]
Owner: [Claude]

schema.title: Response List Sheet Tnc Api V1 Costing Sheets  Sheet Id  Tnc Additions Get

post.description:
Purpose: Add a T&C bullet to a costing sheet.
Inputs: sheet_id (str UUID), TncCreate
Outputs: TncRead
Owner: [Claude]

put.description:
Purpose: Update a sheet-level T&C bullet (bullet_point or display_order).
Inputs: tnc_id (str UUID), TncUpdate
Outputs: TncRead
Owner: [Claude]

delete.description:
Purpose: Delete a sheet-level T&C bullet.
Inputs: tnc_id (str UUID)
Outputs: 204 No Content
Owner: [Claude]

get.description:
Purpose: List global T&C additions (shared across all costing sheets on export).
Inputs: none
Outputs: list[TncRead]
Owner: [Claude]

schema.title: Response List Global Tnc Api V1 Settings Tnc Additions Get

post.description:
Purpose: Create a new global T&C addition.
Inputs: TncCreate
Outputs: TncRead
Owner: [Claude]

put.description:
Purpose: Update a global T&C addition.
Inputs: tnc_id (str UUID), TncUpdate
Outputs: TncRead
Owner: [Claude]

delete.description:
Purpose: Delete a global T&C addition.
Inputs: tnc_id (str UUID)
Outputs: 204 No Content
Owner: [Claude]

post.description:
Purpose: Generate a quote export (DOCX or PDF). Steps:
         1. Compute snapshot_data and render file (outside DB transaction)
         2. Upload to Supabase Storage (outside DB transaction)
         3. INSERT QuoteExport record inside DB transaction (revision_number computed inside txn)
Inputs: scenario_id (str UUID), ExportCreate (file_type)
Outputs: ExportRead
Owner: [Claude]

get.description:
Purpose: List exports for a specific scenario.
Inputs: scenario_id (str UUID)
Outputs: list[ExportRead]
Owner: [Claude]

schema.title: Response List Scenario Exports Api V1 Scenarios  Scenario Id  Exports Get

get.description:
Purpose: List all exports for a costing sheet across all scenarios and file types.
Inputs: sheet_id (str UUID)
Outputs: list[ExportRead]
Owner: [Claude]

schema.title: Response List Sheet Exports Api V1 Costing Sheets  Sheet Id  Exports Get

get.description:
Purpose: Return a signed Supabase Storage URL for downloading an export file.
Inputs: export_id (str UUID)
Outputs: ExportDownloadResponse (signed_url, expires_in_seconds, metadata)
Owner: [Claude]

delete.description:
Purpose: Delete an export record and its Supabase Storage file.
         After deletion, sheet/scenario may become deletable if no exports remain.
Inputs: export_id (str UUID)
Outputs: 204 No Content
Owner: [Claude]

get.description:
Purpose: Return a rendered HTML preview of the quote for on-screen display.
         Same data and template as PDF export. Raw text/html response.
         Frontend must fetch() with Authorization header and inject via iframe srcdoc.
Inputs: scenario_id (str UUID)
Outputs: HTML string (text/html)
Owner: [Claude]

Purpose: List active products with optional category and name filters.
Inputs: category (Optional[str]), name (Optional[str])
Outputs: list[ProductRead]
Owner: [Claude]

schema.title: Response List Products Api V1 Products Get

post.description:
Purpose: Create a new product in the catalogue.
Inputs: ProductCreate
Outputs: ProductRead
Owner: [Claude]

get.description:
Purpose: Get a single product by ID (active only).
Inputs: product_id (str UUID)
Outputs: ProductRead
Owner: [Claude]

put.description:
Purpose: Update a product's fields.
Inputs: product_id (str UUID), ProductUpdate
Outputs: ProductRead
Owner: [Claude]

delete.description:
Purpose: Soft-delete a product. Existing line items using it are unaffected (fields copied on add).
Inputs: product_id (str UUID)
Outputs: 204 No Content
Owner: [Claude]

get.description:
Purpose: List all scenario templates.
Inputs: none
Outputs: list[TemplateRead]
Owner: [Claude]

schema.title: Response List Templates Api V1 Scenario Templates Get

post.description:
Purpose: Create a new scenario template.
Inputs: TemplateCreate
Outputs: TemplateRead
Owner: [Claude]

get.description:
Purpose: Get a template with all its line items.
Inputs: template_id (str UUID)
Outputs: TemplateRead
Owner: [Claude]

put.description:
Purpose: Update a template's name or notes_exclusions.
Inputs: template_id (str UUID), TemplateUpdate
Outputs: TemplateRead
Owner: [Claude]

delete.description:
Purpose: Delete a scenario template and all its line items (cascades).
Inputs: template_id (str UUID)
Outputs: 204 No Content
Owner: [Claude]

post.description:
Purpose: Apply a template to a costing sheet — copy all template line items and notes
         into a new Scenario. No FK link to template; changes to template don't affect this sheet.
Inputs: template_id (str UUID), sheet_id (str UUID)
Outputs: dict with new scenario_id
Owner: [Claude]

schema.title: Response Apply Template Api V1 Scenario Templates  Template Id  Apply  Sheet Id  Post

get.description:
Purpose: Return all global settings (logo URL, signature URL).
Inputs: none
Outputs: list[SettingRead]
Owner: [Claude]

schema.title: Response Get All Settings Api V1 Settings Get

put.description:
Purpose: Update a global setting value by key.
Inputs: key (str path param), SettingUpdate (value: any JSON)
Outputs: SettingRead
Owner: [Claude]

AccessToken.title: AccessToken
AccessToken.description:
Purpose: New access token returned by POST /auth/refresh.
Inputs: N/A (response body)
Outputs: access_token, token_type
Owner: [Claude]

BundleOverridePatch.title: BundleOverridePatch
BundleOverridePatch.description:
Purpose: Body for PATCH /line-items/{line_item_id}/bundle-override.
         Set bundle_override_price to activate override; send null to clear it.
Inputs: bundle_override_price (Decimal or None)
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

ComputedLineItemPricing.title: ComputedLineItemPricing
ComputedLineItemPricing.description:
Purpose: Derived pricing values for a single line item.
         Injected by the router layer after calling pricing_service.compute_line_item_pricing.
Inputs: N/A (computed, not from DB)
Outputs: cost_sgd, selling_rate_sgd, line_total_sgd
Owner: [Claude]

ContactAutocomplete.title: ContactAutocomplete
ContactAutocomplete.description:
Purpose: Lightweight item for contact autocomplete dropdown.
Inputs: N/A (response body)
Outputs: id, name, email
Owner: [Claude]

ContactCreate.title: ContactCreate
ContactCreate.description:
Purpose: Body for POST /organisations/{org_id}/contacts.
Inputs: name, email, phone
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

ContactRead.title: ContactRead
ContactRead.description:
Purpose: Contact details in list and get responses.
Inputs: N/A (response body)
Outputs: id, organisation_id, name, email, phone, created_by_user_id, timestamps
Owner: [Claude]

ContactUpdate.title: ContactUpdate
ContactUpdate.description:
Purpose: Body for PUT /contacts/{contact_id}.
Inputs: name, email, phone (all optional)
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

CostingSheetCreate.title: CostingSheetCreate
CostingSheetCreate.description:
Purpose: Body for POST /costing-sheets.
         ref_number is auto-generated; date defaults to today.
Inputs: quote_title, client_name, organisation_id, contact_id, contact_name,
        contact_email, payment_term, quotation_validity_days, lead_time,
        local_tax, warranty, general_notes
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

CostingSheetList.title: CostingSheetList
CostingSheetList.description:
Purpose: Lightweight item for GET /costing-sheets list response.
         Does not include scenarios or line items.
Inputs: N/A (response body)
Outputs: id, ref_number, quote_title, date, client_name, contact_name, timestamps
Owner: [Claude]

CostingSheetRead.title: CostingSheetRead
CostingSheetRead.description:
Purpose: Full CostingSheet response including nested scenarios.
         Line items are NOT embedded here — loaded per-scenario via separate endpoint.
Inputs: N/A (response body)
Outputs: all header/terms fields + scenarios list
Owner: [Claude]

CostingSheetUpdate.title: CostingSheetUpdate
CostingSheetUpdate.description:
Purpose: Body for PUT /costing-sheets/{sheet_id}.
         All fields optional for partial update.
Inputs: any subset of CostingSheet header/terms fields
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

ExportCreate.title: ExportCreate
ExportCreate.description:
Purpose: Body for POST /scenarios/{scenario_id}/exports.
Inputs: file_type ('docx' | 'pdf')
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

ExportDownloadResponse.title: ExportDownloadResponse
ExportDownloadResponse.description:
Purpose: Response for GET /exports/{export_id}/download.
         Returns a signed Supabase Storage URL valid for a short TTL.
Inputs: N/A (response body)
Outputs: signed_url, expires_in_seconds, export metadata
Owner: [Claude]

ExportRead.title: ExportRead
ExportRead.description:
Purpose: QuoteExport record in list responses.
         Does not include snapshot_data to keep payload small.
Inputs: N/A (response body)
Outputs: id, costing_sheet_id, scenario_id, user_id, revision_number, file_type, file_path, exported_at
Owner: [Claude]

FXRateOverrideCreate.title: FXRateOverrideCreate
FXRateOverrideCreate.description:
Purpose: Body for POST /costing-sheets/{sheet_id}/fx-overrides.
         Upserts: if a record already exists for (sheet_id, base_currency, target_currency),
         it is replaced.
Inputs: base_currency, override_rate, target_currency (always SGD)
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

FXRateOverrideRead.title: FXRateOverrideRead
FXRateOverrideRead.description:
Purpose: FX override record in list/get responses.
Inputs: N/A (response body)
Outputs: id, costing_sheet_id, base_currency, target_currency, override_rate, timestamps
Owner: [Claude]

FXRateOverrideUpdate.title: FXRateOverrideUpdate
FXRateOverrideUpdate.description:
Purpose: Body for PUT /fx-overrides/{override_id}.
Inputs: override_rate
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

LineItemCreate.title: LineItemCreate
LineItemCreate.description:
Purpose: Body for POST /scenarios/{scenario_id}/line-items.
Inputs: section, description, qty, unit, cost_rate, cost_currency,
        markup_pct, contingency_pct, display_order, sub_specs,
        is_bundle_parent, parent_line_item_id (for sub-components)
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

LineItemRead.title: LineItemRead
LineItemRead.description:
Purpose: Full line item response including computed pricing fields.
         Computed fields (cost_sgd etc.) are injected at the router layer, not from DB.
Inputs: N/A (response body)
Outputs: all stored fields + ComputedLineItemPricing + sub_components (recursive for bundles)
Owner: [Claude]

LineItemUpdate.title: LineItemUpdate
LineItemUpdate.description:
Purpose: Body for PUT /line-items/{line_item_id}.
         Sub-component updates automatically clear parent bundle override.
Inputs: all LineItem fields (all optional for partial update)
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

LiveRatesResponse.title: LiveRatesResponse
LiveRatesResponse.description:
Purpose: Response for GET /fx/live-rates.
         Returns current exchange rates from open.er-api.com (1hr cached).
Inputs: N/A (response body)
Outputs: base, rates dict
Owner: [Claude]

LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest
LoginRequest.description:
Purpose: Credentials for POST /auth/login.
Inputs: username (str), password (str)
Outputs: N/A (request body)
Owner: [Claude]

OrganisationAutocomplete.title: OrganisationAutocomplete
OrganisationAutocomplete.description:
Purpose: Lightweight item for autocomplete dropdown.
Inputs: N/A (response body)
Outputs: id, name
Owner: [Claude]

OrganisationCreate.title: OrganisationCreate
OrganisationCreate.description:
Purpose: Body for POST /organisations.
Inputs: name (str), address (Optional[str])
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

OrganisationRead.title: OrganisationRead
OrganisationRead.description:
Purpose: Organisation details in list and get responses.
Inputs: N/A (response body)
Outputs: id, name, address, created_by_user_id, created_at, updated_at
Owner: [Claude]

OrganisationUpdate.title: OrganisationUpdate
OrganisationUpdate.description:
Purpose: Body for PUT /organisations/{org_id}.
Inputs: name (Optional[str]), address (Optional[str])
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

ProductCreate.title: ProductCreate
ProductCreate.description:
Purpose: Body for POST /products.
Inputs: category, name, description, sub_specs, default_cost_price,
        default_currency, default_unit, default_markup_pct, default_contingency_pct
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

ProductRead.title: ProductRead
ProductRead.description:
Purpose: Product record in list/get responses.
Inputs: N/A (response body)
Outputs: all Product fields (excluding hashed_password, deleted_at)
Owner: [Claude]

ProductUpdate.title: ProductUpdate
ProductUpdate.description:
Purpose: Body for PUT /products/{product_id}.
Inputs: all fields optional for partial update
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

ReorderItem.title: ReorderItem
ReorderItem.description:
Purpose: Single item in a reorder request — id + new display_order.
Owner: [Claude]

ReorderRequest.title: ReorderRequest
ReorderRequest.description:
Purpose: Body for PUT /scenarios/{scenario_id}/line-items/reorder.
         Bulk update of display_order for all top-level items in a scenario.
Inputs: items (list of {id, display_order})
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

ScenarioCreate.title: ScenarioCreate
ScenarioCreate.description:
Purpose: Body for POST /costing-sheets/{sheet_id}/scenarios.
Inputs: name, discount_type, discount_value, show_gst, notes_exclusions, display_order
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

ScenarioRead.title: ScenarioRead
ScenarioRead.description:
Purpose: Scenario response (without line items — loaded separately for performance).
Inputs: N/A (response body)
Outputs: all Scenario fields + optional totals
Owner: [Claude]

ScenarioTotals.title: ScenarioTotals
ScenarioTotals.description:
Purpose: Aggregated totals for a scenario.
         Computed from all visible line items, applying discount and optional GST.
Inputs: N/A (computed)
Outputs: subtotal_sgd, discount_amount_sgd, total_before_gst_sgd, gst_amount_sgd, grand_total_sgd
Owner: [Claude]

ScenarioUpdate.title: ScenarioUpdate
ScenarioUpdate.description:
Purpose: Body for PUT /scenarios/{scenario_id}.
Inputs: all fields optional
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

SettingRead.title: SettingRead
SettingRead.description:
Purpose: GlobalSetting record in list/get responses.
Inputs: N/A (response body)
Outputs: id, key, value, timestamps
Owner: [Claude]

SettingUpdate.title: SettingUpdate
SettingUpdate.description:
Purpose: Body for PUT /settings/{key}. Updates a global setting value.
Inputs: value (any JSON-serialisable value)
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

TemplateCreate.title: TemplateCreate
TemplateCreate.description:
Purpose: Body for POST /scenario-templates.
Inputs: name, notes_exclusions, template_line_items
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

TemplateLineItemRead.title: TemplateLineItemRead
TemplateLineItemRead.description:
Purpose: TemplateLineItem in template get response.
Inputs: N/A (response body)
Outputs: all TemplateLineItem fields + sub_components (recursive for bundles)
Owner: [Claude]

TemplateRead.title: TemplateRead
TemplateRead.description:
Purpose: Full ScenarioTemplate with top-level line items.
Inputs: N/A (response body)
Outputs: id, name, notes_exclusions, template_line_items, timestamps
Owner: [Claude]

TemplateUpdate.title: TemplateUpdate
TemplateUpdate.description:
Purpose: Body for PUT /scenario-templates/{template_id}.
Inputs: name, notes_exclusions (both optional)
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

TncCreate.title: TncCreate
TncCreate.description:
Purpose: Body for POST /.../tnc-additions. Creates a new T&C bullet.
Inputs: bullet_point, display_order
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

TncRead.title: TncRead
TncRead.description:
Purpose: T&C Addition record in list/get responses. Used for both sheet-level
         (CostingSheetTncAddition) and global (GlobalTncAddition).
Inputs: N/A (response body)
Outputs: id, bullet_point, display_order, costing_sheet_id (None for global), timestamps
Owner: [Claude]

TncUpdate.title: TncUpdate
TncUpdate.description:
Purpose: Body for PUT .../tnc-additions/{id}. Updates a T&C bullet.
Inputs: bullet_point, display_order (both optional)
Outputs: N/A
Owner: [Claude]

TokenPair.title: TokenPair
TokenPair.description:
Purpose: Access + refresh token pair returned on successful login.
Inputs: N/A (response body)
Outputs: access_token, refresh_token, token_type
Owner: [Claude]

TokenRefreshRequest.title: TokenRefreshRequest
TokenRefreshRequest.description:
Purpose: Request body for POST /auth/refresh.
Inputs: refresh_token (str)
Outputs: N/A (request body)
Owner: [Claude]

UserRead.title: UserRead
UserRead.description:
Purpose: Authenticated user details returned by GET /users/me.
Inputs: N/A (response body)
Outputs: id, numeric_user_id, username, created_at
Owner: [Claude]
